newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-LIVERPOOL'S FOWLER UP FOR FAIR PLAY AWARD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LIVERPOOL'S FOWLER UP FOR FAIR PLAY AWARD.

text.p: Liverpool's Robbie Fowler is in the running for a fair play award from world governing body FIFA for protesting that he had not been fouled when a referee gave a penalty in his favour during a key late season league match.
FIFA president Joao Havelange was so impressed by the incident that he said Fowler should go on the short list for FIFA's 1997 Fair Play Prize, a FIFA spokesman said on Thursday.
The incident took place during Liverpool's English premiership game against Arsenal on March 24.
